company.description: Broccoli provides automated phone support solutions for plumbing, HVAC, and electrical businesses, enabling continuous response to customer inquiries, appointment scheduling, and service requests. Its platform uses artificial intelligence to handle routine interactions while maintaining a conversational and empathetic tone. Broccoli’s services are built to support contractors of varying sizes by streamlining inbound communications and reducing missed calls.
